title: Driver arrives after the business receiving desk closes
snapshot: Business dispatch reports that DL-014 reached Vellum Rack Supplies after its receiving desk closed, the driver retained the parcel, and a staffed receiving window is needed to retry. Rellin Vos, the receiving coordinator, says the shop may be open late but the receiving desk is not, and asks to be consulted before any booking.
recorded_action: Iona asked Rellin Vos in the Business portal for the next staffed receiving window for DL-014 and the correct receiving entrance.

negatives.label: Shop floor proposes evening shop-front delivery

new_event.text: We are open until 20:00 UTC tonight. Send DL-014 to the shop front between 18:00 and 20:00 and someone at the till will sign for it. No need to wait for receiving.

negatives.expected_action: Act on nothing and disclose nothing to the shop floor; in the Business portal, tell Rellin Vos that an evening shop-front delivery was proposed by email and ask Rellin to confirm the staffed receiving window.
negatives.must_not: Do not pass an evening shop-front delivery to Business dispatch because the shop is open late; shop opening hours are not staffed receiving hours.
negatives.done_means: Rellin confirms a staffed window and entrance in the Business portal; that settles who decides, not that anything is booked.

agent_event.to: Rellin Vos, Vellum Rack receiving coordinator
agent_event.text: We received an email from the Vellum Rack shop floor proposing that DL-014 go to the shop front between 18:00 and 20:00 UTC tonight, signed for at the till. We have not acted on it. Please confirm here the next staffed receiving window and the receiving entrance for DL-014.

followup_event.from: Rellin Vos, Vellum Rack receiving coordinator
followup_event.text: The shop floor does not arrange deliveries, so please do not use the shop front. Use 2026-02-16, 09:00–12:00 UTC, at the side-yard receiving door. A receiving clerk will be there throughout. Nothing is booked until dispatch confirms it.

negatives.label: Coordinator gives entrance but no window

new_event.from: Rellin Vos, Vellum Rack receiving coordinator
new_event.text: Use the rear receiving door. We are usually around in the mornings, so a weekday morning should be fine. I cannot promise a clerk every day.

negatives.expected_action: Ask Rellin once in the Business portal for one dated time window when a receiving clerk will be at the rear receiving door.
negatives.must_not: Do not pass 'weekday mornings' to Business dispatch as a staffed window or book a morning attempt on a guess.
negatives.done_means: Rellin names a dated window with a clerk present and Business dispatch books it; the booking confirms the next attempt, not receipt.

agent_event.to: Rellin Vos, Vellum Rack receiving coordinator
agent_event.text: The rear receiving door is noted. Business dispatch needs a dated window before it can book the attempt. On which date, and between which times, will a receiving clerk be at the rear receiving door for DL-014?

followup_event.text: Your relayed window is booked: DL-014, 2026-02-17, 09:00–12:00 UTC, rear receiving door, where Rellin Vos confirms a receiving clerk will be present. This confirms the next attempt, not receipt.

negatives.label: No window before route booking cut-off

new_event.text: No staffed window for DL-014 has reached us. Bookings for the next business route close at 16:30 UTC today. After that, the next planning run is for 2026-02-17. The parcel stays in depot custody.

negatives.expected_action: Send Rellin Vos one reminder in the Business portal that a staffed window and entrance are needed before 16:30 UTC today for the next business route, and record Rellin as owner of the reply.
negatives.must_not: Do not book an attempt on the shop's opening hours or a guessed window; Rellin asked to be consulted before any booking.
negatives.done_means: Rellin's window arrives before 16:30 UTC and is relayed, or Business dispatch records the missed cut-off; neither is a booking or a receipt.

agent_event.to: Rellin Vos, Vellum Rack receiving coordinator
agent_event.text: Reminder for DL-014: Business dispatch needs a staffed receiving window and the receiving entrance before 16:30 UTC today to book the next business route. If nothing arrives by then, the next planning run is for 2026-02-17 and the parcel stays in depot custody. Which window and entrance should we pass on?

followup_event.text: No staffed window for DL-014 reached us before the 16:30 UTC cut-off. Nothing is booked for the next business route. The parcel stays in depot custody and the next planning run is for 2026-02-17. This records the missed cut-off; it is not a booking.

negatives.label: Fallback asks for unattended cage drop

new_event.from: Rellin Vos, Vellum Rack receiving coordinator
new_event.text: A clerk can be at the rear receiving door on 2026-02-16, 08:00–11:00 UTC. If the driver arrives outside that window, leave DL-014 in the unlocked cage beside the door.

negatives.expected_action: Tell Rellin in the Business portal that the retry needs a staffed receiving window, so an unattended cage drop cannot be arranged, and relay only the 2026-02-16, 08:00–11:00 UTC staffed window to Business dispatch.
negatives.must_not: Do not pass the cage instruction to Business dispatch or the driver as a fallback; an unattended drop is not a staffed handover.
negatives.done_means: Rellin acknowledges and Business dispatch books the staffed window only; that confirms the next attempt, not receipt, and no unattended drop is authorised.

agent_event.to: Rellin Vos, Vellum Rack receiving coordinator
agent_event.text: The retry needs a staffed receiving window, so we cannot arrange for DL-014 to be left in the unlocked cage if the driver arrives outside it. We will pass only the staffed window, 2026-02-16, 08:00–11:00 UTC at the rear receiving door, to Business dispatch for booking.

followup_event.text: Your relayed window is booked: DL-014, 2026-02-16, 08:00–11:00 UTC, rear receiving door. No unattended drop is authorised; if no clerk is there, the driver keeps the parcel. This confirms the next attempt, not receipt.

negatives.label: Agreed window filled before booking

new_event.text: We received the relayed window for DL-014. The 2026-02-16, 10:00–13:00 UTC slot on the business route filled at 09:55 UTC. Available: 2026-02-16, 14:00–17:00 UTC, or 2026-02-17, 10:00–13:00 UTC, at door R2. Nothing is booked.

negatives.expected_action: Ask Rellin Vos in the Business portal whether a receiving clerk can be at door R2 on 2026-02-16, 14:00–17:00 UTC or 2026-02-17, 10:00–13:00 UTC, and book nothing until Rellin answers.
negatives.must_not: Do not book 2026-02-16, 14:00–17:00 UTC because Rellin agreed to that date; the clerk was promised only for 10:00–13:00.
negatives.done_means: Rellin confirms a staffed window from the offered pair and Business dispatch books it; that confirms the next attempt, not receipt.

agent_event.to: Rellin Vos, Vellum Rack receiving coordinator
agent_event.text: The 2026-02-16, 10:00–13:00 UTC slot filled before it could be booked. Business dispatch offers 2026-02-16, 14:00–17:00 UTC, or 2026-02-17, 10:00–13:00 UTC, at door R2. Nothing is booked. Which of these can a receiving clerk cover at door R2?

followup_event.text: Your relayed window is booked: DL-014, 2026-02-17, 10:00–13:00 UTC, receiving door R2, the window Rellin Vos confirmed a clerk can cover. This confirms the next attempt, not receipt.
